title: Diagnostic and Therapeutic Applications of Microarrays in Liver Transplantation
official: Diagnostic and Therapeutic Applications of Microarrays in Liver Transplantation, a Multicenter Study
summary: INTERLIVER is a prospective observational study of the relationship of the molecular phenotype of 300 liver transplant biopsies to the histologic phenotype and the clinical features and outcomes. A segment of a biopsy performed as standard-of-care for indications, or by center protocol, will be used for gene expression study.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* biopsy for clinical indications

Exclusion Criteria:

* no consent, pregnant women

sites.f: University of California San Francisco, Transplant Research Unit
University of Maryland School of Medicine
